title: Boho - Project management for small agencies
text: Boho is project management built for small agencies. Plan work on Kanban boards and Gantt timelines, share progress through branded client portals, and log hours with built-in time tracking. Assign tasks, set due dates and milestones, attach files, and keep comments next to the work. Clients get free logins to review and approve deliverables without buying a seat. Weekly timesheets roll up automatically for billing. Integrates with Slack, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Teams, with apps for web, iOS, and Android. Plans start at $12 per user per month, with a 14-day free trial and no credit card.
